prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Orientation Module Screen: Adds a dedicated interactive orientation screen before the final completion screen to teach users how to summon, move, hide, and talk to their desktop pet.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_controls", "home_intro"], "new_desktop_controls": {"headline": "Quick Desktop Controls Guide", "body": "Learn how to summon, click, drag, and toggle your pet's desktop presence in a few simple taps.", "layout": "centered", "components": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Desktop Shortcuts Overview", "style": "rounded"}]}}
1: [choose_path, redesign] Centered Journey Pathways Redesign: Redesigns the path choice screen into a centered layout with distinct card visualizers for adopting standard presets vs generating custom pets.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "centered", "headline": "Select Your Pet Experience", "body": "Pick a ready-to-play pet or craft a customized companion from your photos."}}
2: [adoption, new_flow] Custom Photo Quality Assistant Flow: Adds a new validation step during photo upload that checks image clarity and gives live feedback prior to pet rendering.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "new_photo_validator", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "new_photo_validator": {"headline": "Photo Clarity Inspection", "body": "We checked your image to ensure the best rendering quality on your desktop.", "layout": "card"}}

   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "stage", "headline": "Summoning Your Desktop Pet", "body": "Preparing desktop environment and initializing rendering engine...", "show_progress": true}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Existing Account Restore Verification Hint: Adds explicit sign-in hint text reassuring returning users that signing in restores all previous pet profiles automatically.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Signing into an existing account safely recovers all previous pets and customizations."}}
5: [adoption, copy] Certificate Name Entry Guidance Copy: Updates the adoption certificate copy to clarify that naming the pet is quick and can be modified anytime in settings later.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"headline": "Official Adoption Certificate", "body": "Give your new companion a name. You can change this at any time in app settings."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Desktop Spawn Troubleshooter Wait Info: Adds a troubleshooting hint and timer delay on the waiting screen for users experiencing slow desktop spawning.
   config: {"waiting": {"hint": "If pet initialization takes longer than 30 seconds, verify desktop notification permissions.", "tip_delay_seconds": 15}}
7: [finish, notification] System Tray Quick Hide Notification Switch: Enables a system ready notification toggle on home intro along with instructions on using the system tray icon to control pet visibility.
   config: {"home_intro": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Use the system tray icon anytime to quickly hide or show your desktop companion."}}
8: [choose_path, incentive] Instant Desktop Companion Path Incentive: Adds a highlighted time-estimate badge on choose_path comparing instant preset adoption with photo customization.
   config: {"choose_path": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Ready in 10s vs 2 mins custom", "style": "highlight"}]}}
9: [sign_in, layout] Compact Layout for Sign In Screen: Switches the sign-in step to a compact layout to minimize layout shifts and streamline authentication.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Sign In to Save Companion Data"}}

verdicts.reason: Valid addition of a desktop controls orientation screen within onboarding.
Redesigned path selection screen retains both adoption and custom pet choices.
Valid addition of a photo quality verification screen inside onboarding.
Redesigned waiting screen continues to show pet creation progress.
Sign-in hint text provides clear information without violating rules.
Adoption certificate copy update maintains official certificate function.
Troubleshooting hint and tip delay on waiting screen comply with fair wait rules.
Notification toggle and hint on home intro are valid onboarding modifications.
Time estimate comparison badge on choose path complies with all rules.
Compact layout update for sign-in screen maintains sign-in job.
